candidates.why_maybe_new: Not on roster: P8299 Lakeshore Lateral is a different line (La Grange to Mount Pleasant, 46 km). Rochester Lateral is 33 mi (about 53 km), in the slice. Data center tie is indirect: the CT plant is for Microsoft-driven load per GOGPT and press; the lateral's stated need is firm deliverability for southeast Wisconsin and the CTs. Needs vetting of the Microsoft tie.
